fol.notes: Members are numbered: the seventeen listed ones are 1 to 17 (distinct by arithmetic), the two new ones are the constants harrowgarde_1 and harrowgarde_2; membership in the class is a belief (uninterpreted). The edit is the class rule plus the two members it speaks of ('one of the two ... found in 2024'): two different individuals, neither on the old list. Counting needs a closed world: every member the model knows of is a listed one or one of the two new ones (presupposition, what the count rule rests on). w1 stores the figure (number_known), which the edit does not recompute; w2 stores the counting rule over the list (each new member counted once and only if not already listed), so the number follows from the list plus the edit.
